name: AutixAI lead intake — CONFIGURE BEFORE ACTIVATION

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
lead AS (INSERT INTO autixai_leads(id,created_at,payload) SELECT d->>'id',(d->>'createdAt')::timestamptz,d FROM input ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id),
notification AS (INSERT INTO autixai_outbox(lead_id,kind) SELECT id,'team_notification' FROM lead ON CONFLICT(lead_id,kind) DO NOTHING RETURNING lead_id),
followup AS (INSERT INTO autixai_followups(lead_id) SELECT id FROM lead ON CONFLICT(lead_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING lead_id)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('status','accepted','durable',true,'id',d->>'id','followUpCreated',true,'acknowledgementSent',false) AS receipt FROM input;
